title: Design Underwriting That Mirrors Your Credit Team's Real Workflow
summary: We understand the unique complexity of the underwriting process. Most credit teams start with a quick screen to rule out obvious declines, dig deeper once documents arrive, and make a final call after pulling in additional data and closing documents. Each step builds on the last, using new information and tighter criteria as confidence increases. What matters just as much as the individual checks is how smoothly they connect into a single, continuous workflow. That’s the reality Lendflow is designed to support and why we’re excited to enable our partners with the launch of multiple underwriting stages to more closely matching their real workflows.
